title: How a Sink P-Trap Keeps Your Air Clean
description: The P-trap is a critical component located directly beneath a sink basin. Its curved design holds a small volume of standing water after every use, forming a continuous physical barrier between the building interior and the municipal sewer line. As wastewater drains, gravity fills the dip, displacing old water while retaining a clean seal. This static water trap prevents harmful sewer gases, bacteria, and insects from rising up through the drain opening, making it an essential passive safety feature in modern sanitary plumbing systems.
